claim_boundary.supported: The first authenticated Red living-Dex inventory attempt failed closed after private-input authentication and before any behavior draw, controller authority, emulator frame, root claim, outcome observation, teacher query, model prediction, fit, or plan publication.

diagnostic_gap.finding: The path-free receipt retained only the broad action_free_inventory stage. It cannot distinguish an authentication, namespace, historical-replay, menu-projection, or exact 8+4 coverage failure. Treating this as a proven coverage shortfall would overclaim the evidence.

next_gate.purpose: Qualify a V2 action-free diagnostic boundary without reopening protected inputs. Every private-stage failure must map to a finite path-free reason and preserve aggregate state-read, exclusion, eligible-partition, offered-kind, family, location, overlap, and zero-effect counters. Only a new published V2 identity may perform another authenticated inventory; it keeps the exact 8+4 gate unchanged and stops again on a genuine shortfall.

product_interpretation: This is a useful safety falsifier and a diagnostic-design failure, not a model, gameplay, completion, authority, or transfer result. The project remains aimed at a transferable living-Pokedex agent; Red is still only its first curriculum.
